facts.summary: Phase 1 data showed 71% ORR but low 6-month durability and CRS/ICANS cases · Phase 1 · ADI-001 in B-cell NHL · not yet approved
facts.indication: relapsed or refractory aggressive B-cell non-Hodgkin's lymphoma

evidence.summary: ADI-001 demonstrated 71% overall response rate (ORR) and 63% complete response (CR) rate across all dose levels in patients with median 4 prior lines of therapy
evidence.safety: ADI-001 was generally well-tolerated in the study and there were no occurrences of dose-limiting toxicities or graft vs host disease (GvHD).
